taste.style_directive: Refined flat vector illustration style with no outlines: subjects are built from clean geometric planes of solid colour, rendered in a restrained two-tone treatment that pairs a single deep teal accent (#006884) with a warm off-white ground (#FBF8F6). Keep shading minimal and non-atmospheric — no gradients, no textures, no decorative background scenery — and preserve generous negative space around the subject on a light background. Compared with the rejected line-art option, forms are filled rather than drawn in outline; compared with the rejected soft-gradient option, tonal depth and ambient background ornament are deliberately omitted to stay calm and utilitarian.
